notes: 2026-09-06 04:04:41 UTC: 2026-09-06 04:05 UTC: Key-rotation incident and repair. The SPY-trade soak stayed up through the Alpaca key rotation, but the staggered Container App revision rollout (old revisions cached the revoked key) produced a 17-minute disruption window (2026-09-06 01:07:16-01:24:20 UTC) during which 233 SPY|trade sessions (session dates 2022-08-02..2023-08-02, newest-first cursor range traversed in that window) were written as error coverage rows with AlpacaHTTPError HTTP 401; the soak driver recorded generic recheck-budget failures and moved on, self-recovering at 01:24. Repaired via a single range ensure with a different spec hash (equity/trade/SPY 2022-08-02..2023-08-02, job ensure-36ffa8a7e51de034d70db81833a620a13637c7a8ada571135caa19c212880df4, succeeded in ~4 minutes); full-range coverage verification shows all 252 sessions complete with row_count=1000 and no residual errors. Known defect to file: ensure with the same spec short-circuits on the stale SUCCEEDED job record, so single-session re-ensure can never repair errored sessions; the driver recheck also cannot surface coverage error_message.
acceptance: Soak completes or resumes safely and produces auditable per-session volume measurements

tasks.title: Ensure re-runs repair errored sessions and soak results surface provider errors
tasks.description: Fix the coverage-ensure short-circuit that made the 2026-09-06 key-rotation gaps unrepairable: ensure_coverage returns the existing durable job record as-is whenever one exists, so re-ensuring a spec whose sessions ended in error status never relaunches the ingest, and the soak driver's recheck then times out against the stale SUCCEEDED record with only a generic message. Change ensure_coverage to supersede a terminal job record (SUCCEEDED or FAILED) when the current coverage report still has non-terminal sessions, relaunching the ingest for those sessions while keeping the short-circuit for in-flight QUEUED or RUNNING records so concurrent duplicate ensures remain idempotent. Change the soak driver's recheck to query coverage directly once the ensure reaches a terminal state and record the provider error_message in the results file so future incidents identify the real failure instead of the generic recheck-budget text.
notes: 2026-09-07 17:43:22 UTC: 2026-09-06 04:15 UTC: Created from the key-rotation incident diagnosis on T049 (233 SPY-trade sessions errored 2026-09-06 01:07-01:24 UTC; repaired manually via a different-spec range ensure). Implements options A and C approved by the orchestrator; option B (truthful job states in the hosted runtime) is a possible fast-follow. C: LakeClient gained a coverage(request) GET method (and _request accepts query params), and the soak driver's ensure_session now reads coverage directly after a succeeded job, returning the provider error_message for failed sessions instead of the generic recheck-budget text; the generic text remains only for repeated coverage-read failures.
